summary.en: Pea-sized “master gland” hanging from the base of the brain.
summary.zh: 豌豆大小的“内分泌之王”，悬于脑底。

detail.en: Sits in the sella turcica of the sphenoid bone, connected to the hypothalamus by the infundibulum. The anterior lobe (adenohypophysis) secretes GH, TSH, ACTH, FSH, LH and prolactin; the posterior lobe (neurohypophysis) releases oxytocin and ADH made in the hypothalamus.
detail.zh: 位于蝶骨垂体窝内，借漏斗与下丘脑相连。前叶（腺垂体）分泌生长激素、促甲状腺激素、促肾上腺皮质激素、卵泡刺激素、黄体生成素和催乳素；后叶（神经垂体）释放下丘脑合成的缩宫素和抗利尿激素。

clinical.en: Pituitary tumours may compress the optic chiasm and cause bitemporal hemianopia.
clinical.zh: 垂体肿瘤可压迫视交叉，引起双颞侧偏盲。

summary.en: Butterfly-shaped gland in the front of the neck.
summary.zh: 位于颈前部的蝴蝶形腺体。

detail.en: Two lateral lobes joined by an isthmus lying across the 2nd to 4th tracheal rings; it moves upward on swallowing. The recurrent laryngeal nerve runs close to its posterior surface. Four parathyroid glands lie on its posterior surface.
detail.zh: 由左、右侧叶和连接两叶的甲状腺峡组成，峡部位于第2~4气管软骨环前方，吞咽时随喉上下移动。喉返神经紧贴其后面走行；甲状旁腺有4个，位于其后面。

function.en: Secretes T3 and T4 to regulate metabolic rate, and calcitonin to lower blood calcium.
function.zh: 分泌T3和T4调节基础代谢率，分泌降钙素降低血钙。

clinical.en: Thyroidectomy risks injury to the recurrent laryngeal nerve (hoarseness) and removal of the parathyroids (hypocalcaemia).
clinical.zh: 甲状腺切除术有损伤喉返神经（声嘶）和误切甲状旁腺（低钙血症）的风险。

summary.en: Paired glands capping the upper pole of each kidney.
summary.zh: 成对的腺体，位于两肾上极。

detail.en: The right gland is pyramidal and the left is crescent-shaped. The cortex has three zones (glomerulosa, fasciculata, reticularis: “GFR”) producing aldosterone, cortisol and androgens; the medulla secretes adrenaline and noradrenaline.
detail.zh: 右侧呈三角形，左侧呈半月形。皮质由外向内分球状带、束状带和网状带，分别分泌醛固酮、皮质醇和性激素；髓质分泌肾上腺素和去甲肾上腺素。

clinical.en: Pheochromocytoma of the medulla causes paroxysmal hypertension, sweating and palpitations.
clinical.zh: 髓质嗜铬细胞瘤可引起阵发性高血压、出汗和心悸。
